title: Current state of open source force fields in protein-ligand binding affinity predictions
authors: David F. Hahn; Vytautas Gapsys; Bert L. de Groot; David L. Mobley; Gary J. Tresadern
one_liner_zh: 该文评估不同开源力场在蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测中的表现，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-配体而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: In drug discovery, the in-silico prediction of binding affinity is one of the major means to prioritize compounds for synthesis. Alchemical relative binding free energy (RBFE) calculations based on molecular dynamics (MD) simulations is nowadays a popular approach for accurate affinity ranking of compounds. MD simulations rely on empirical force field parameters, which strongly influence the accuracy of the predicted affinities. Here, we evaluate the ability of six different small-molecule force fields to predict experimental protein-ligand binding affinities in RBFE calculations on a set of 598 ligands and 22 protein targets. The public force fields OpenFF Parsley and Sage, GAFF and CGenFF show comparable accuracy, while OPLS3e is significantly more accurate. However, a Consensus approach using Sage, GAFF and CGenFF leads to accuracies comparable to OPLS3e. While Parsley and Sage are performing comparable based on aggregated statistics across the whole dataset, there are differences in terms of outliers. Analysis of the force field reveals that improved parameters lead to significant improvement in the accuracy of affinity predictions on subsets of the dataset involving those parameters. Lower accuracy cannot only be attributed to the force field parameters, but is also dependent of input preparation, and sampling convergence of the calculations. Especially large perturbations and non-converged simulations lead to less accurate predictions. The input structures, Gromacs force field files as well as the analysis python notebooks are available on github.
abstract_zh: 在药物发现中，基于计算机的结合亲和力预测是对化合物进行合成优先级排序的主要手段之一。基于分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟的炼金术相对结合自由能（relative binding free energy, RBFE）计算，如今是对化合物进行精确亲和力排序的流行方法。MD模拟依赖于经验力场参数，这些参数强烈影响预测亲和力的准确性。在此，我们评估了六种不同的小分子力场在RBFE计算中预测实验蛋白质-配体结合亲和力的能力，数据集包含598个配体和22个蛋白质靶标。公共力场OpenFF Parsley和Sage、GAFF及CGenFF显示出相当的准确性，而OPLS3e则显著更准确。然而，使用Sage、GAFF和CGenFF的共识（Consensus）方法达到了与OPLS3e相当的准确性。尽管基于整个数据集的汇总统计，Parsley和Sage表现相当，但在异常值方面存在差异。力场分析揭示，改进的参数在涉及这些参数的数据子集上显著提高了亲和力预测的准确性。较低的准确性不仅可归因于力场参数，还取决于输入准备和计算的采样收敛性。特别是大的扰动和未收敛的模拟导致预测准确性降低。输入结构、Gromacs力场文件以及分析Python笔记本可在github上获取。
